text.autoconfig.dynamicnutrition.title: Dynamic Nutrition
Nutrient strip on the HUD
Show a compact five colour strip above the hunger bar.
HUD strip, horizontal offset
Move the strip sideways, in pixels, if another mod is already using that space.
HUD strip, vertical offset
Move the strip up or down, in pixels. Negative is up.
Inventory button
Show a small button in the inventory that opens the nutrition screen. The keybind works either way.
Inventory button, horizontal offset
Move the button sideways, in pixels, if it collides with another mod's.
Inventory button, vertical offset
Move the button up or down, in pixels. Negative is up.
Nutrients on food tooltips
Add a line to every food tooltip showing what it is worth. Hold F3 and H for where the values came from.
Status effects
Apply the Malnourished and Well Nourished effects. The bars still move either way.
Announce status changes
Say on the action bar when your overall status changes, and which nutrient caused it.
Variety matters
Eating the same food over and over is worth less nutrition. Hunger is never affected.
Meals remembered
How many recent meals count towards repetition. Higher is stricter.
Repeat penalty
How much of a meal each repeat costs, as a percentage.
Least a meal can be worth
A repeated food never drops below this percentage, so one food source is never a dead end.
Hearts lost when malnourished
Maximum hearts removed by the Malnourished effect. Zero leaves the effect without the health penalty.
Hearts gained when well nourished
Extra maximum hearts granted by the Well Nourished effect. Zero leaves the effect without the health bonus.
